title: Children taught physics by 'the ghost'

tellings.quote: I've met with some families where the kids I've been graciously allowed to speak with the kids and the kids have said Well, the the the um the the the ghost comes and tells me.

plain: Dave Rossi, who says aliens taught him advanced physics, says he has met families whose children told him that a being they call "the ghost" comes and teaches them. He tells Michels that the parents let him speak with the children directly, and that the kids said, "the ghost comes and tells me." If so, it would mean other children are being taught the same way he says he was.
